name: projekt-skills
description: Connect a Projekt organization and automate tasks, docs, workloads, estimations and time tracking through the Projekt REST API with your own Personal Access Token — and use Projekt as an AI-context store (memories ↔ docs, Serena-style). Plus `projekt-tokens`: measure a session's real token cost from the local transcripts and install the context rules that cut it. Token-efficient, Markdown-native, dry-run by default. Soporta español.
